name: qasm2 dump parse
task_prompt:
Dump a 3-qubit QuantumCircuit containing only a single X on qubit 2 to OpenQASM 2 text with qiskit.qasm2.dumps, re-load it with qasm2.loads, and return the loaded circuit's num_qubits.
You must implement this using a function named `qasm2_roundtrip_qubits` taking no arguments.
